claimed_root_cause: Per-course teacher authorization depends on Google-issued role data.
description: Teacher-only Classroom views require both the session user and a TEACHER role extracted from the caller's own Classroom API response.

evidence.description: Teacher list/detail routes call the teacher gate with session-derived owner id.
Course content and grades use the same teacher gate shape.
Role extraction reads only the caller's Classroom API response, not request parameters.

title: Teacher-role enforcement depends on live Google membership
